text: I'm fixing the two card problems I can see in the screenshot: the cards stacked behind run into the counters row, and the long card gets cut off at the bottom with no sign that it scrolls.
The type check passes. Next I'll check it in Firefox.
Still checking it in Firefox: I'm building the web app and a mock feed to show a long card.

Your message ended at "Card issues:", so I fixed the two problems I could see in the screenshot. Both are in `apps/app/src/app/(tabs)/feed.tsx`:

1. **The cards behind ran into the counters.** On a phone, the stack started too close to the counter pills, so the top edges of the two cards behind sat under them. The stack now starts lower, and those edges show clearly below the counters.
2. **A long card looked cut off.** When a card goes on below the screen, the text simply stopped at the bottom edge, with no sign you could scroll it. Now the bottom of the card fades out while there's more below, and the fade goes away once you've scrolled to the end.

The type check passes. I checked it in Firefox at phone size in dark mode, using a built copy of the app and a made-up feed with a long card. The stack now clears the counters and the fade shows at the bottom. I didn't scroll that card to its end to watch the fade disappear.

If you meant other card issues, tell me what they are and I'll fix them too. [Feed screen](Frontend/Screen/feed) is the screen entity for this.
